title: Count Negatives
description: Write a function that counts how many negative numbers are in a list. A negative number is any number less than zero. For example, in the list [-1, 2, -3, 4, -5] there are 3 negative numbers.
instructions: Complete the count_negatives function so it returns the count of negative numbers in the list.
hints: Loop through each number in the list and check if it is less than zero.
Keep a counter variable that you increment each time you find a negative number.
Remember: 0 is not negative, so don't count it.
